learning_outcomes.text: Gain experience in research methodology and in the analysis and writing of scientific results according to rules generally accepted by the scientific community.
In-depth study of a specific subject of Materials Science and Engineering (preparation, properties, use and technological applications).
Participation in research processes based on international bibliography.
Enrichment of knowledge and analytical skills.
Development of critical thinking and a sense of cooperation.
Gain of experience in the search and analysis of data and information, using the necessary technologies.

assessment_rules: Students are evaluated by: Writing of Thesis (80%) and Oral presentation and examination (20%).
bibliography: According to the topic of the thesis
Related academic journals: Suggested for presentations
degree: Materials Science and Engineering — Πτυχίο Τμήματος Επιστήμης και Μηχανικής Υλικών (first cycle, 240 ECTS, curriculum ΕΜΥ)
